name: simple-vlog-editor
description: Understand and edit complete videos in the visible SimpleVlogEditor through its local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Understand and edit videos through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Controls the visible SimpleVlogEditor timeline, inspects synchronized speech and source frames, and applies reversible video edits through a local MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Edit this whole vlog on your own: understand every clip, rebuild the story, cut mistakes and dead air.
Inspect every clip and create a clean rough cut.
Add captions, Behind Subject titles, QR tags and subtle push-ins.
